all application deposits within 30 days of such disapproval. Refund checks may be made payable to all co-applicants and mailed

state or federal holiday, the deadline will be extended to the end of the next business day.

WAITLIST POLICY

Leasing is based on a first-come, first-served basis. Once the community has leased the total units held at each designation type to
100% capacity, this waitlist policy will be implemented in order to assist in filling subsequent vacancies. When an accessible unit
becomes vacant, Cypress Creek at Stoney Ridge will first prioritize applicants requesting an accessible unit, prior to offering such
units to a non-handicapped applicant or current resident.

A separate wait list will be kept for each income category. Applicant(s) will be placed on the waitlist in chronological order by the
date the application is received in the office, and by the preference of apartment home size and income designation.

When the applicant’s name reaches the top of the waitlist and the type of apartment requested becomes available, the staff will
begin contacting the applicant(s) via the e-mail address and/or phone number provided on the application(s). If the applicant(s)
is/are unable to be reached and does/do not respond back to the Community within 24 hours, there will be a 2nd attempt to contact
the applicant(s). If the applicant(s) is/are not reached on the 2nd attempt and fails to respond again within the allotted time frame of
the 2nd attempt, the applicant(s) will be subject to removal from the waitlist. Upon removal from the waitlist, the next applicant(s)
will be offered the available unit.

Once the applicant(s) are contacted to apply, shall the applicant(s) decline the opportunity, they may remain on the waitlist and will
be placed at the bottom of the waitlist. After the applicant(s) has/have declined 3 offers that meet their preferences the Community

reserves the right to remove the applicant(s) from the waitlist.

Upon acceptance of the offer, applicant(s) will be required to complete an application packet within 48 hours. The applicant(s) will
be required to provide the requested documentation to the Community. If the applicant(s) fail to provide their required
documentation, the Community reserves the right to remove the applicant(s) from the waitlist. If the application is denied for any
reason or if the applicant(s) exceeds the current income limit they will be contacted and informed that they have been removed from
the waitlist; however, they could be placed on another applicable waitlist.

All existing residents are eligible to be placed on the wait list for a lower rent restricted unit and will be placed on the wait list at the
time of their request. When a lower rent restricted unit becomes available, the existing resident on the corresponding waitlist will
be contacted. At that time, a determination will be made regarding the existing resident’s eligibility. If the most recent certification
of income is within 120 days and indicates income within the guidelines for the lower rent restricted unit, the set aside for the unit
will be changed and the applicable rent will be applied. If household income has not been certified within 120 days, a certification
of income will be completed to ensure the household qualifies for the lower rent restricted unit.

The waitlist will remain open until an announcement stating otherwise is posted at the leasing office. We will close our waitlist when
the average wait for a unit type is greater than one year. We will reopen the waitlist when the average wait time for a unit type is less
than six months. The date and time of closure will be stated within the closure notification and will be posted at the leasing office.
